arxiv-2107-01408.title: Scale Mixtures of Neural Network Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2107-01408.creator: Hyungi Lee, Eunggu Yun, Hongseok Yang, Juho Lee
arxiv-2107-01408.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hyungi Lee, Eunggu Yun, Hongseok Yang, Juho Lee. Recent works have revealed that infinitely-wide feed-forward or recurrent neural networks of any architecture correspond to Gaussian processes referred to as Neural Network Gaussian Processes (nngps) . While these works have extended the class of neural networks converging to Gaussian processes significantly, however, there has been little focus on broadening the class of stochastic processes that such neural networks converge to.

arxiv-2303-10581.title: An Evaluation of GPU Filters for Accelerating the 2D Convex Hull
arxiv-2303-10581.creator: Roberto Carrasco, Héctor Ferrada, Cristóbal A. Navarro, Nancy Hitschfeld
arxiv-2303-10581.description: Abstract The Convex Hull algorithm is one of the most important algorithms in computational geometry, with many applications such as in computer graphics, robotics, and data mining. Despite the advances in the new algorithms in this area, it is often needed to improve the performance to solve more significant problems quickly or in real-time processing.

arxiv-2309-10419.title: Learning from Teaching Assistants to Program with Subgoals: Exploring the Potential for AI Teaching Assistants CCS: Social and professional topics Computing education CCS: Applied computing Interactive learning environments
arxiv-2309-10419.creator: Changyoon Lee, Junho Myung, Jieun Han, Jiho Jin, Alice Oh
arxiv-2309-10419.description: Abstract . With recent advances in generative AI, conversational models like ChatGPT have become feasible candidates for TAs. We investigate the practicality of using generative AI as TAs in introductory programming education by examining novice learners’ interaction with TAs in a subgoal learning environment.

arxiv-2402-11229.title: Spin dynamics and dark particle in a weak-coupled quantum Ising ladder with 𝒟 8 ( 1 ) \mathcal{D}_{8}^{(1)} spectrum
arxiv-2402-11229.creator: Yunjing Gao, Xiao Wang, Ning Xi, Yunfeng Jiang, Rong Yu, Jianda Wu
arxiv-2402-11229.description: Abstract Emergent Ising 2 h {}_{h}^{2} integrability is anticipated in a quantum Ising ladder composed of two weakly-coupled critical transverse field Ising chains. The system is remarkable for including eight types of massive relativistic particles, with their scattering matrix and mass spectrum characterized by the 𝒟 8 ( 1 ) \mathcal{D}_{8}^{(1)} Lie algebra.

arxiv-2506-01052.title: A Finite-Time Analysis of TD Learning with Linear Function Approximation without Projections nor Strong Convexity
arxiv-2506-01052.creator: Wei-Cheng Lee, Francesco Orabona
arxiv-2506-01052.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wei-Cheng Lee, Francesco Orabona. We investigate the finite-time convergence properties of Temporal Difference (TD) learning with linear function approximation, a cornerstone algorithm in reinforcement learning. While prior work has established convergence guarantees, these results typically rely on the assumption that each iterate is projected onto a bounded set or that the learning rate is set according to the unknown strong convexity constant—conditions that are both artificial and do not match the current practice.

arxiv-2507-01152.title: SonoGym: High Performance Simulation for Challenging Surgical Tasks with Robotic Ultrasound
arxiv-2507-01152.creator: Yunke Ao, Masoud Moghani, Mayank Mittal, Manish Prajapat, Luohong Wu, Frederic Giraud, Fabio Carrillo, Andreas Krause, Philipp Fürnstahl
arxiv-2507-01152.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yunke Ao, Masoud Moghani, Mayank Mittal, Manish Prajapat, Luohong Wu, Frederic Giraud, Fabio Carrillo, Andreas Krause, Philipp Fürnstahl. Ultrasound (US) is a widely used medical imaging modality due to its real-time capabilities, non-invasive nature, and cost-effectiveness. Robotic ultrasound can further enhance its utility by reducing operator dependence and improving access to complex anatomical regions.

pmc-11496717.title: Skull evolution and lineage diversification in endemic Malagasy carnivorans
pmc-11496717.creator: Chris J. Law, Tate J. Linden, John J. Flynn
pmc-11496717.description: Madagascar is one of the world’s foremost biodiversity hotspots with more than 90% of its species endemic to the island. Malagasy carnivorans are one of only four extant terrestrial mammalian clades endemic to Madagascar. Although there are only eight extant species, these carnivorans exhibit remarkable phenotypic and ecological diversity that is often hypothesized to have diversified through an adaptive radiation.

pmc-11686611.title: Patient Pain and Function after Correction of Posterior Malleolar Malunion
pmc-11686611.creator: Hui Zhang, Yaxing Li, Tingjiang Gan
pmc-11686611.description: Category:Trauma; HindfootIntroduction/Purpose:The management of an ankle malunion involving the posterior malleolus remains challenging, and only a few published studies described the operative treatment of complex posterior malleolar malunion. A transfibular approach allows for direct visualization of the articular reduction of the posterior malleolus, but the reports of its use for correcting posterior malleolar malunion are rare.

pmc-12712579.title: Autonomic Symptoms in Post-Treatment Lyme Disease: Insights From the COMPASS-31 and the 10-Minute Active Stand Test
pmc-12712579.creator: Brittany L Adler, Alison W Rebman, Tae Chung, John B Miller, Marzieh Keshtkarjahromi, Ting Yang, Chatuthanai Savigamin, Alba Azola, Peter C Rowe, John N Aucott
pmc-12712579.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveTo determine the prevalence of autonomic symptoms in post-treatment Lyme disease (PTLD) and identify clinical factors that associate with abnormal hemodynamics on the 10-minute active stand test.Patients and MethodsWe administered the Composite Autonomic Symptom Score-31 survey to 37 patients with PTLD and compared them with a cohort of patients with postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) without a known history of Lyme disease.

pmc-13092441.title: Fermented Plant-Derived Phytoconstituents in Biocosmetics: Pharmacological Enhancements and Applications
pmc-13092441.creator: Suhaera Suhaera, Suci Fitriani Sammulia, Deshanda Kurniawan Prayoga, Zelika Mega Ramadhania, Soraya Ratnawulan Mita, Adryan Fristiohady, Tiana Milanda
pmc-13092441.description: The application of plant-derived extracts in dermatological and cosmeceutical formulations is often limited by poor bioavailability, low skin permeability, and the instability of bioactive compounds. Fermentation has emerged as a promising biotechnological approach to enhance phytochemical composition and biological activity through microbial biotransformation.

pmc-13204196.title: The Effects of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists on Retinal Microvascular Alterations
pmc-13204196.creator: Stamatios Lampsas, Gerasimia-Marina Chardalia, Chrysa Agapitou, Konstantinos Papastamopoulos, Panagiotis Theodossiadis, Gerasimos Siasos, Evangelos Oikonomou, Vaia Lambadiari, Irini Chatziralli
pmc-13204196.description: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have revolutionized the management of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) by providing robust glycemic control alongside significant cardioprotective and renoprotective benefits. This review synthesizes current mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical evidence regarding the impact of GLP-1RAs on retinal microvasculature and summarizes the current clinical evidence of GLP-1RA-induced retinal complications.

pmc-13681414.title: A copy-number variation generates a long-noncoding RNA that enhances ClBige1b expression to suppress cell expansion and seed growth in watermelon
pmc-13681414.creator: Jianfei Song, Dan Zhou, Jianshu Zheng, Zhanpeng Tang, Nannan Li, Mengya Cao, Jianli Shang, Shuangwu Ma, Na Li
pmc-13681414.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Seed size is a key agronomic trait in watermelon: large seeds are favorable for sowing, whereas small-seeded watermelons are preferred for consumption. However, the causal genetic variations and underlying mechanisms that govern seed size in watermelon remain poorly understood. Here, we identified a copy-number variation (CNV) tightly linked to seed size; a single copy is present in large-seeded watermelons, whereas four copies are present in small-seeded lines.
